units.passage: La Universidad no se hace responsable del uso individual de la IA ni de las consecuencias personales que puedan afectar al usuario, y/o a un tercero, como resultado de su uso.
units.policy: The University is not responsible for individual use of AI or the personal consequences to the user or a third party resulting from it.
units.why: "La Universidad no se hace responsable del uso individual de la IA ni de las consecuencias personales"; the institution disclaims liability for individual use, P114.

units.policy: If a person not linked to the University causes the damage, that person alone answers for it, exonerating the University, and is barred from using the technology at the University.
units.why: A non-affiliated person who causes IP damage "responderá exclusivamente por el daño causado, eximiendo y exonerando a la Universidad"; the institution disclaims liability, P114.

units.passage: The university also faces the challenge of limited formal agreements with most external AI tool providers, meaning standard university security and privacy protections may not apply.

units.why: 'limited formal agreements with most external AI tool providers, meaning standard university security and privacy protections may not apply' (P114).
